mapper.insert: insert into sdsshop.u_m_goods_partner( shop_code, goodscode, partnercode, partnername, inboundtimes, lastdoccode, lastdocdate, lastcostprice, createtime ) values( #{shopCode}, #{goodsCode}, #{partnerCode}, #{partnerName}, 1, #{docCode}, #{docDate}, #{costPrice}, sysdate() ) on duplicate key update inboundtimes = inboundtimes + 1, partnername = values(partnername), lastdoccode = if(lastdocdate is null or #{docDate} >= lastdocdate, values(lastdoccode), lastdoccode), lastcostprice = if(lastdocdate is null or #{docDate} >= lastdocdate, values(lastcostprice), lastcostprice), lastdocdate = if(lastdocdate is null or #{docDate} >= lastdocdate, values(lastdocdate), lastdocdate)
